name: Silves
mandate: PrompTugal.news Silves: AI and technology in Silves, the Algarve's orange capital and old regional capital, and what reaches Silves from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Silves is a large, mostly rural municipality of six parishes and about 680 square kilometres, known as the orange capital of the Algarve and as the old capital of the Kingdom of the Algarve. Citrus is its signature crop: in 2016 the council's brand launch cited about 2,200 farmers and some 6,000 hectares of oranges, and a regional official put Silves at around 40 percent of the Algarve's citrus area. The council says its business life rests on industrial platforms in Algoz, Alcantarilha and São Bartolomeu de Messines, and it runs a local entrepreneurship office, GEL.

sources.title: Silves já é «capital da laranja» (Barlavento, 14 April 2016)

look.landmark: Silves Castle, the red sandstone fortress above the Arade river
look.motif: orange groves under a red sandstone castle

ai_news.title: Silves council and Turismo de Portugal run a free advanced AI-for-business course
ai_news.summary: Silves's Formação + Próxima programme, a partnership of the council, Turismo de Portugal and the Portimão hotel and tourism school, held an advanced course called AI at the service of business at the municipal library on 26 and 27 March 2026. It was free, certified and open to tourism professionals and companies, with registration through Turismo de Portugal's digital academy.
ai_news.ai_path: The course teaches AI directly, and the Silves council hosts it for local businesses.

ai_news.title: AI and robots for citrus: the ATTENTIA project, with the University of Algarve
ai_news.summary: ATTENTIA, a cross-border Interreg project, applies AI and robotics to citrus crop management in Andalusia and the Algarve-Alentejo area. It is led by the University of Huelva with the University of Algarve and the University of Seville, and runs from 1 September 2023 to 31 December 2026. The project sheet does not name Silves.
ai_news.ai_path: Silves is the Algarve's orange capital, and this project builds AI methods for Algarve citrus orchards. It is the nearest AI project to Silves's main crop, but the sheet does not say any of the work is in Silves.

ai_map.name: Câmara Municipal de Silves
ai_map.what: The municipal council. It co-hosts the free Formação + Próxima training for the local tourism sector, which included an advanced AI-for-business course in March 2026, and it runs the GEL entrepreneurship office.
ai_map.ai_path: It hosts AI training for local businesses.

extras.label: Fully digital master plan
extras.value: The council says Silves was the first in the Algarve with a second-generation, fully digital municipal master plan (PDM), in force since 12 January 2021, with a new revision being prepared. This is digital, not AI.

extras.label: Coworking
extras.value: The council says it opened coworking spaces in São Marcos da Serra and São Bartolomeu de Messines at the end of 2021. A 2025 opinion column said Silves was one of four Algarve municipalities with no incubator, business centre, accelerator or coworking space, citing AMAL.

extras.label: Membership of AMAL
extras.value: Silves is one of the 16 municipalities listed by AMAL, whose digital programmes include AlgarveMaisDigital and Região Inteligente Algarve. AMAL's page does not say whether Silves takes part in them.

gaps: We found no AI company, startup or research group based in Silves in public sources. The AI map holds only the council, and that is a finding, not an oversight.

We found no AI event in Silves with a date still ahead on the council's agenda (read 15 November 2026, first pages only). A search snippet mentions a Silves AI-for-SMEs session on 16 and 20 November 2026, but the page behind it is behind a bot challenge, so we do not list it until we can read an open source.
The council's news page gave us no feed. Its site has no RSS link, so the council's own news cannot be followed automatically yet.
Postal do Algarve, Terra Ruiva, RUA FM and Agroportal returned bot challenges or refusals, so we did not read them. Barlavento and Sul Informação load and have feeds.
The citrus figures we could open are from 2016. A current source for Silves's citrus area and farmers, and any digital or AI use on its farms, is still to find.

Sources to look for next: the Associação de Regantes de Silves, Lagoa e Portimão on irrigation technology, the citrus producers' groups, the industrial platforms in Algoz and Alcantarilha, and the companies behind the Fábrica do Inglês project.

voice.lede: Eh pá, Silves: a capital of the Algarve before it was cool, still guarding its laranjas from a castle the colour of a ripe tangerine.

Oranges are the star: in 2016 the council cited about 2,200 farmers and some 6,000 hectares, and an official put Silves at around 40 percent of the Algarve's citrus area. The câmara says business lives in the industrial platforms of Algoz, Alcantarilha and São Bartolomeu de Messines, with the GEL office to help.
